notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Implemented widescreen resolutions when in fullscreen mode.
[*] Fixed crash issue in Bandao and certain other levels when in fullscreen mode.
[*] Added additional details to tutorials.
[*] Display unit upkeep on their summary under territory management.
[*] Hide unit summary except on mouse over.
[*] Fix EXP bar on unit summaries.
[*] Improve readability in intro.
[/list]

Special thanks to everyone who has provided feedback and bug reports so far!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33554140/e571c4b530e5acdd246be241c48e6ef6d99d7606.png[/img]

[h1]After years of development, we're proud to finally announce our final release date![/h1]

Of Gods And Men: The Daybreak Empire is set to release on November 9th 2018 for PC on Steam and Itch.io. Our retro, story-driven, turn-based tactics game will be on sale for 40% off at $4.99 USD for the first week! Please wishlist it so you don't miss it!

[h1]Additionally, we've launched a [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/deadgenre/shop?asc= u]RedBubble[/url] store with some cool merch and a [url=https://deadgenrestudios.bandcamp.com/releases]Bandcamp[/url] page with our soundtrack![/h1]

notes.title: Beta!
notes.content:
After nearly three years of (on and off) development we're finally ready to begin the beta testing phase of our first game, [i]Of Gods and Men: The Daybreak Empire[/i]. Release is intended for November 2018, but only our beta test results will give us a more solid idea when the exact date will be. 

[h1]In the meantime, head on over to [url=https://deadgenre.itch.io/daybreakempire]itch.io[/url] to try out our updated demo![/h1]
